newsitem.title: USA: NAPM index 51.7 in Sept versus 52.6 in Aug.
newsitem.headline: NAPM index 51.7 in Sept versus 52.6 in Aug.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management said Tuesday its monthly index of manufacturing activity fell last month, indicating a slowdown in the manufacturing sector of the economy.
The report, viewed as a key indicator of the economy's performance, said the index fell to 51.7 in September from 52.6 in August.

A reading above 50 indicates an expanding economy, while one below 50 indicates a slowdown. The report was slightly weaker than forecast by Wall Street economists, and the inflation-sensitive 30-year U.S. Treasury bond gained about a third of a point, pulling its yield down to 6.90 percent from 6.92 percent late Monday.
